provenance.provider: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (Copernicus ERA5 reanalysis)
provenance.license: CC BY 4.0 (Copernicus ERA5 data via Open-Meteo); Open-Meteo free API is non-commercial terms. License pointers: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en and https://open-meteo.com/en/terms . Attribution: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) / ECMWF ERA5; access via Open-Meteo.com.
provenance.resolution: 0.25 degree (ERA5 grid); daily aggregates. The ~0.1 degree ERA5-Land stream was probed at this cell on 2026-11-15 and returned all-null for every requested variable (including 10 m wind), so it is NOT used. The Open-Meteo archive serves these GHI and wind 10/100 m variables at this cell only from ERA5.

parameters.ghi: shortwave_radiation_sum - daily sum of surface solar shortwave downward radiation (GHI), MJ/m2/day
parameters.wind_10m: wind_speed_10m_mean - daily mean 10 m wind speed, m/s (wind_speed_unit=ms)
parameters.wind_100m: wind_speed_100m_mean - daily mean 100 m wind speed, m/s (wind_speed_unit=ms)
parameters.wind_direction_10m: wind_direction_10m_dominant - dominant (vector) daily wind direction at 10 m, degrees true
parameters.wind_direction_100m: wind_direction_100m_dominant - dominant (vector) daily wind direction at 100 m, degrees true

provenance.gaps: None. All 3653 calendar days 2015-01-01..2024-12-31 are present and non-null for all five series (checked 2026-11-15). ERA5 archive has a ~5-day publication delay; 2024-12-31 precedes that, so this record is complete as served. Reanalysis is not a site measurement and not a forecast issued before the event.
provenance.processing: Raw Open-Meteo daily response retained unchanged (daily aggregates computed by Open-Meteo from ERA5 hourly). No regridding, gap filling or recalibration. Hourly values are NOT included in this file and must not be committed to the repo.
provenance.uncertainty: Reanalysis estimate on a 0.25 degree grid cell - not a pyranometer or anemometer reading at any rooftop or turbine site; single sample cell, not a catchment or array average; no local calibration or error bounds. 100 m wind is modelled, not measured. Day-to-day variability and interannual spread are the honest uncertainty signal available here.
provenance.hourlyNote: Hourly data is deliberately excluded (file-size and scope discipline); only daily aggregates ship.
